title: I edit my reels by texting my AI agent
hook: I've got my Hermes agent to be able to edit my videos via text.
summary: AI video editing by text: I reply to my reel on Telegram and my AI agent re-edits it while I'm out.
body: AI video editing by text: I reply to my reel on Telegram and my AI agent re-edits it while I'm out.

Here's how it works:
1. Hermes sends me a preview of the edit on Telegram (version 3)
2. I reply with what I want changed
3. Hermes spins up Claude Code on my computer at home and makes the edits
4. Version 4 lands on Telegram and in my Google Drive "edit for CapCut" folder
5. I do a final voice clean-up in CapCut and post
Comment VIDEO EDIT and I'll send you how it's set up.
